name: Комбінація (4)
description:
In a combination, you use multiple tactical concepts at the same time. Sometimes you also sacrifice material temporarily, in order to win it back with interest.

What do you have to do?

Win material by means of a combination.

examples.text: The knight on f5 looks strong, but is actually unstable. Black has a strong combination by capturing on e4.
There is a lot going on in this position. Black has a well-known trick with 1...Nxd4! 2.Qxd4 Nxe4! and because of the discovered attack towards the white queen, white is suddenly in huge trouble.

texts: A triple attack! The white queen, bishop, and pawn on f2 are under fire.
